title: Zero duration lists hang playback
summary: Accepted durations={0,0} causes update(0.1) to loop without consuming time.

title: pauseAtStart stops on final frame
summary: Lowering disables looping and runtime bypasses the named loop method.

title: Loop callbacks lose multi-wrap counts
summary: Callbacks always receive 1 per forward wrap, making documented loops > 1 condition unreachable.
